[b]Random Fact of Gwynyvyrn:[/b]

Yr Bwystfil is the highest peak in Gwynyvyrn, located within the center of the country in the County of Penmorwyn, rising up to 6,000 feet. The name means "The Beast" in English, referring to it being a high, rugged, and mighty. Gwynish culture and religion, however, says there is a deceased or sleeping God or Beast beneath it.

[spoiler= The Iron Wave - Natural Expansion Post (~1000 Words)]As the thousands of Jomish citizens gathered in Heiðabýr to await news from Blæjuvirki, the evening air was alive with excitement. Following in the footsteps of his father, Magnus II., Jomsland had made great progress under Jorik Ill's rule in regaining lost territory and bringing its people back together. Even though he had accomplished a lot, Jorik III. understood that reestablishing contact with Blæjuvirkia region rich in common history but cut off for more than 200 yearswas essential to bringing Jomsland back to its former glory.By blood and custom, Blæjuvirki, which lies south of the Sverker Bay, has always been a part of Jomsland. Nevertheless, for centuries, a council that adhered to stringent isolationist policies ruled over its remote tundras, taigas, and volcanic ashlands. The Elders' Council upheld maintaining Blæjuvirki independence and customs was essential to its survival. But the council had been dealing with increasing dissatisfaction in recent years, particularly from the younger generations. These young Blæjuvirki residents started to doubt the council's strict control after being inspired by Jomsland's recovery and enthralled by stories of a united country prospering under the Second Commonwealth.A Blæjuvirkian man by the name of Gustav Weynaldsson led the charge. He had heard tales of Jorik III.s valor, the Jomish struggle to retake the Teutonic Bay, and the nation's tenacity in rising to its former glory since he was a child. Being an accomplished historian and orator, Gustav identified with Jomsland's warrior ancestry and understood that Blæjuvirkis identity was inextricably linked to their kinship. He longed for Blæjuvirki to embrace its position within the Second Commonwealth and sensed the innate urge to take action.He spoke to a crowd in the largest city of Blæjuvirki, Westrfjold, one brisk Januar evening. People were huddled together in front of him, their breaths mingling in the night air as they were covered in furs to protect themselves from the cold. The words "our past may be divided by time," he said, resonating throughout the square, "but the legacy of Jom Blodskald is woven into our blood, our culture, and our very souls." How can we forget our kin who haven't forgotten us? Whispers of support became louder as the square's energy surged. Protests demanding an end to the council's rule broke out throughout Blæjuvirki in the days that followed. Thousands of people marched in the direction of the Iron Wave, a fortified wall that was built centuries ago to regulate any interactions between Kaldhavn and the Sverker Bay Region near their tectonic divide. Jorik III. and his advisers in Heiðabýr watched with cautious optimism as the events in Blæjuvirki played out. The High King was a youthful but astute leader who understood the fine balance needed to bring Blæjuvirki and Jomsland back together. Jorik III. stood at a critical juncture after his father had given his life in the effort to regain Jomsland's power and retake important areas like the Sverker Bay and The Teutonic Bay.Would it be he who, by choice rather than by conquest, brought the dream of a united Jomslandic Empire to fruition?Seeing that Blæjuvirkis future was at a turning point, Jorik contacted Gustav and invited him to Heiðabýr to talk. He was astounded by the ancient city, which Jom Blodskald himself had founded, when he finally made it there. Above the busy streets rose towers made of stone, wood, glass, and concrete, adorned with the symbols of contemporary businesses and the heraldry of ancient-old clans. He met with the High King at the Bondahall palace, a man whose presence exuded strength and modesty.The greeting "Welcome to Heiðabýr, Gustav" was given by Jorik in a warm but serious tone. "I've heard about your courage, and I see the spirit of our ancest in you. Although Blæjuvirkis destiny is up to its citizens, know that Jomsland is prepared to welcome them if they wish to reunite."His words moved Gustav, who outlined his people's complaints and their longing for connection free from the restrictions that had imprisoned them."High King," he retorted, "for too long, the Blæjuvirkis people have been deprived of their culture. Despite being Jomish, we have lived in a prison that we created for ourselves. We hope for a time when we will be able to freely roam our own country with our relatives. Jorik heard the longing in his voice and nodded. He understood that reunification was the reclamation of a legacy that transcends national boundaries and went beyond politics. They came up with a plan to destroy the Iron Wave so that the inhabitants of Blæjuvirki and Jomsland could reunite.By gifting Blæjuvirki autonomy within the Commonwealth, the reunification process would respect its unique identity while acknowledging it as a component of a larger whole.When the day finally came, it was a dark but yet hopeful gray morning. Workers at the Iron Wave chipped away at the centuries-old barrier with picks and hammers. In anticipation of the long-awaited moment, citizens from both sides gathered. Cheers broke out as the wall collapsed, and the Blæjuvirkian and Jomish people embraced for the first time in over 200 years. At the threshold, Jorik and Gustav watched as strangers from both sides told their stories and clans reconnected. A place of warmth and connection replaced the once frigid barrier. Through spirit rather than sword, a new era of unity emerged.Jomsland and Blæjuvirki celebrated the reunification with a flurry of festivities in the weeks that followed. By passing a resolution formally acknowledging Blæjuvirki as a member of the Commonwealth, the Althing preserved its customs and created a lasting relationship. From the steps of Bondahall, Jorik III. spoke to the populace in a proud and respectful manner:"The Iron Wave is no more. It is replaced by the strength of our kinship, which will never be broken by time, distance, or walls. We reaffirm our kinship today, as my father and Jom Blodskald would have desired.
As a result, the Second Commonwealth of Jomsland became more powerful both geographically and morally. Because of the bravery of its citizens, the dreams of Jomsland's ancient heroes continued to exist. Future generations would commemorate the day the Iron Wave fell and Jomsland regained another significant region, and the tale of Blæjuvirkis reunion is destined to become a legend.[/spoiler]

Expansion Post:
[spoiler] Report on the Anraka Expansion Project: 1/23

	With the recent success of the expansion project, officials have decided to continue with further expansion. The following is a list of planned expansion routes preceding the project:

#1: The Island Acquisitions
	With the recent expansion towards the northern coast, we have managed to set up a small port town with which we plan to hopefully focus trade around. In a move to increase potential naval capability, plans were made to occupy a few islands between the Elseyr & Vespurian continents. Plans for this acquisition include resource extraction and potential staging grounds for further expansion to more islands to the east. Ideas of expansion to the Vespurian continent have been considered, but have been sidelined for the moment due to other pursuits.

#2: Expansion to the West Coast
	With new reports of potential resources to our west, we have now shifted attention to the west to occupy land to the west. The expansion plan includes expanding our western border all the way to the west coast. The benefits of this expansion include access to the valuable resources of iron, copper, and lithium, as well as another avenue for coastal exploits. This new plan has unfortunately meant tabling other planned expansions for the time being. There are also concerns of these new lands expanding our border with the UREV, however the reward outweighs the risk in this case.

#3: Expansion Plans to the East
	The third and final expansion plan mainly involves shoring our border up for future plans of expansion. With the previous expansion, we moved eastwards with the plans of expansion to the north. However, debates have started of whether or not we should shift our focus to continuing our northern expansion, or move further east or even plan to expand towards the south towards southern Vespuria. The general consensus is though, that there is major potential of expansion on the Vespurian continent, however further expansion will continue to accrue large costs and should be handled with care.

Future of the Expansion Project:
	Overall, the continuance of the expansion project is the result of the wonderful planning of the president and his government. We have managed to improve our returns on the previous expansion and continue to improve. It is our professional opinion that the continued expansions could make this nation a regional powerhouse, and maybe even a potential superpower on the world stage. However, these goals are still far off, and we must make sure that we dont falter in our ideals in order to reach them.
[/spoiler]
